description: This file defines the declaration of the SleepExecutor class, which implements an ExecutorInterface for scheduling tasks based on time. It includes methods for scheduling by timestamp and for a delay, and references an external scheduler.

classes.name: SleepExecutor
classes.description: A class that provides methods for scheduling execution of tasks based on timestamps or delays, implementing the ExecutorInterface.

methods.name: scheduleByTimestamp
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be run at a specific timestamp, given the scheduling context and parameters.

methods.name: scheduleForLater
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be executed after a specified delay.
